lesson.title: Whether & If: Choices, Conditions & Reported Questions

modules.name: Learn
modules.title: When to Use Whether vs. If
modules.instructions: Master the rules for using whether and if in indirect questions, alternatives, conditional sentences, and after prepositions. Understand formal vs. informal preferences.

modules.name: Write
modules.title: Context-Appropriate Usage
modules.instructions: Write sentences choosing whether or if based on context: alternatives, conditions, reported speech, and formality level.

modules.name: Play
modules.title: Whether/If Decision Games
modules.instructions: Select whether or if for different contexts. Practice recognizing when only one is correct.

modules.name: Apply
modules.title: Key Terms Challenge
modules.instructions: Spell and use: alternative, condition, indirect question, preposition, infinitive, or not, formal, informal.
